comment: Known legitimate divergences between the Rust port (calibrated to dss_capi
0.14.5) and ORIGINAL EPRI OpenDSS engines, consumed by the opt-in EPRI
channel only: corpus_live_opendss partitions its report into known/new and
DSS_LIVE_OPENDSS_ASSERT=1 fails only on NEW divergences; ab_compare.py
--known-diffs reclassifies fully-matching cases as known_diverged.
This is a triage inventory, NOT a mute button: every entry carries a
non-empty `cause`, entries are matched by substring on (case label, panic
reason), first match wins, and per-entry hit counts are reported so dead
entries surface and get pruned as upstream deltas are ported.
NEVER consulted by the mandatory gate or its tolerances.
Entry kinds (`kind`, default 'diff'): 'diff' = the case runs on the listed
revs but legitimately diverges (matched on the failure reason); 'skip' =
the case is not expected to run/converge on the listed revs at all — the
EPRI channel skips the comparison up front (matched on `case_contains`
only; `reason_contains` unused) and reports it under `known_skipped`.
Optional `ab_contains` overrides `reason_contains` when matching
ab_compare.py issue strings (different wording than the Rust panics);
entries without it and without a matching Rust-shaped phrase simply never
reclassify there. Modeled on DSS-Python tests/compare_outputs.py
KNOWN_COM_DIFF (BSD-3), translated to our first-failure-reason match shape.

entries.cause: EPRI 9.8 InvControl fails to converge (hits MaxControlIter) on decks where dss_capi 0.14.5 and the port converge; dss_capi reworked InvControl convergence (cf. DSSCompatFlags.InvControl9611 toggle in DSS-Python).
entries.source: triage 2026-07 r3723 (19 cases, InvControl volt-var/VV_VW/DRC families + controls:invcontrol_vvvw_asym)

entries.cause: Small terminal/voltage deltas on InvControl decks: EPRI's Delphi InvControl and dss_capi's reworked one take different control-iteration trajectories and settle on slightly different fixpoints (same class as epri-invcontrol-maxiter, sub-failure severity).
entries.source: triage 2026-07 r3723 (25 volt-var/VV_VW/DRC '-2.dss' cases)

entries.cause: Solve/control iteration-count deltas: Delphi-vs-FPC last-ulp rounding shifts convergence-check outcomes, and dss_capi's reworked controls iterate differently (AutoTrans+RegControl reg-tap 6-vs-3; GenDispatcher dispatch 20-vs-4 / 31-vs-5 on r4088). The port matches the pinned FPC oracle's EXACT count (mandatory gate green); EPRI's Delphi settles a near-identical state (V ~3.5e-4) in a different number of control iterations.
entries.source: triage 2026-07 r3723 (10 controls cases) + WP-U1.10 r4088 sweep (controls:autotrans_both/autotrans_reg, controls:gendispatcher{,_kvarlimit})

entries.cause: EPRI pads monitor header channel names with a leading space (' VAngle1'); dss_capi strips them.
entries.source: triage 2026-07 r3723 (8 controls cases); cf. DSS-Python compare_outputs.py string handling

entries.cause: dss_capi's rewritten property system renders array-valued PropertyValue with brackets ('[ 1900 1500 2300]'); EPRI returns plain space-separated ('1900 1500 2300') — dss_capi docs/known_differences.md (property system rework).
entries.source: triage 2026-07 r3723 (4 sensor/swtcontrol probe cases)

entries.cause: Storage kWhStored integral drifts by <5e-4 rel after StorageController dispatch steps (2207.9995 vs EPRI 2208, rel ~2e-7): dss_capi's Storage model revision accrues idling losses slightly differently than EPRI's Delphi. The port matches the pinned FPC oracle (mandatory gate green). Same class vs r3723 and r4088 (Storage model byte-identical across the EPRI delta). The .kw dispatch-precision probes are a distinct class, split into storage-kw-display-precision.
entries.source: triage 2026-07 r3723 (3 storagectrl cases) + WP-U1.10 r4088 sweep (6 storagectrl kwhstored probes)

entries.cause: EPRI's Delphi renders the StorageController-dispatched Storage kW property to ~6 significant figures (2122.18) where the port/capi015 return full f64 (~2122.185) — the Delphi-vs-FPC Format/Str last-digit rendering difference §1.3-2 relaxes to numeric-token comparison; the parsed probe diff is property-display precision (rel ~2e-7), not an op-point move (expected == actual rounded to 6 sf). The port matches the pinned FPC oracle (mandatory gate green). Split out from storage-kwhstored-drift (the distinct idling-loss integral class); the `.kw:` term keeps this from swallowing arbitrary Storage number-0 probe diffs.
entries.source: WP-U1.10 r4088 sweep (2 storagectrl .kw dispatch probes); r3723 sweep same class

entries.cause: Injection RHS entries ~1.4x above the calibrated faer-vs-KLU floor (3.9e-6 vs 2.8e-6 allowed) on IndMach-bearing asymmetric decks: Delphi-vs-FPC transcendental last-ulp drift amplified by the machine model — same class as the proven dSpeed cancellation floor, floor calibrated against FPC not Delphi. Identical magnitude vs r3723 and r4088 (injection assembly byte-identical across the EPRI delta).
entries.source: triage 2026-07 r3723 (4 asymmetric cases) + WP-U1.10 r4088 sweep (same 4 cases, same ~3.9e-6)

entries.cause: EPRI's EnergyMeter ZonePCE enumerates one more PCE than dss_capi on the same zone (off-by-one in membership, e.g. source-side element counted); dss_capi reworked zone bookkeeping. Zone bookkeeping is byte-identical across the r3723->r4088 EPRI delta, so the off-by-one is the same on both.
entries.source: triage 2026-07 r3723 (3 energymeter cases: 4v5, 2v3, 25v26) + WP-U1.10 r4088 sweep (4 energymeter + 2 autoadd, e.g. 3v4)

entries.cause: EPRI writes a trailing space after relay event-log action text ('...LOCKED OUT '); dss_capi trims it.
entries.source: triage 2026-07 r3723 (3 relay cases)

entries.cause: Harmonics-mode system-Y trace.im off by 2.9e-5 (allowed 1.6e-5): Delphi-vs-FPC drift in harmonic load/source Y stamps summed over the whole trace; single case, magnitude consistent with transcendental last-ulp accumulation. Same 2.891e-5 vs r3723 and r4088 (harmonics path byte-identical across the EPRI delta; the r4133-side IEEE_519 move is a separate Rung-2 item).
entries.source: triage 2026-07 r3723 + WP-U1.10 r4088 sweep (HarmonicsVariableLoad/IEEE_519.DSS, same magnitude)

entries.cause: AutoTrans + RegControl reg-tap resolves on a different discrete step FPC(dss_capi/port) vs EPRI(Delphi): a last-ulp voltage nudges the tap decision across a boundary, moving the atf node V ~2.4e-2 (rel ~3.6e-7). The port matches the pinned FPC oracle (mandatory gate green); the committed capi015<->r4088 sweep shows the same 'regcontrols differ: [rat]' engine-to-engine, so it is FPC-vs-Delphi, not a port bug. Paired with iteration-count-delta (autotrans_both/_reg 6-vs-3).
entries.source: WP-U1.10 r4088 sweep (controls:autotrans/midi_autotrans{,_both}); r3723 sweep same class

entries.cause: MakePosSequence positive-sequence reduction last-digit drift FPC(port) vs EPRI(Delphi): the reduction averages/collapses the model, amplifying transcendental last-ulp so node V drifts rel ~6e-6..4e-5 (above the tight makeposseq gate tier). The port matches the pinned FPC oracle (mandatory gate green); capi015<->r4088 confirms makeposseq drifts engine-to-engine.
entries.source: WP-U1.10 r4088 sweep (6 modes:makeposseq cases); r3723 sweep same class

entries.cause: Circuit-reduction produces a different reduced network FPC(port) vs EPRI(Delphi): reduce keep/merge/switch handling collapses branches differently, so a reduced Line YPrim can differ structurally (e.g. a merged branch vs a retained pseudo-switch Y=500) and node V drifts. The port matches the pinned FPC oracle's reduced network EXACTLY (mandatory gate green, incl. YPrim); capi015<->r4088 confirms reduce_mergeparallel drifts engine-to-engine. Reduction is not a Rung-1 item (not in WP-U1.*).
entries.source: WP-U1.10 r4088 sweep (6 modes:reduce cases: 5 YPrim + reduce_mergeparallel); r3723 sweep same class

entries.cause: ckt24 substation RegControl/LDC tap-current at the SubXFMR ultra-switch (1e-8 ohm stitch, Y~1e8 S): the near-cancellation floors at rel ~1.2e-7, and Delphi-vs-FPC last-ulp nudges the substation node V (entry 4/5) ~1.2x over the faer-vs-KLU-calibrated pinned tol. Documented conditioning floor (STATUS CF-D 'SubXFMR ultra-switch'); the port matches the pinned FPC oracle (mandatory gate green). Same magnitude vs r3723 and r4088 (feeder unchanged across the EPRI delta).
entries.source: WP-U1.10 r4088 sweep (11 ckt24 decks: EPRITestCircuits + ADiakoptics/Torn_Circuit + MemoryMappingLoadShapes); r3723 sweep same class

entries.cause: EPRI's Delphi renders the PVSystem kvar property to ~6 significant figures (-28.3773) where the port/capi015 return full f64 (-28.3772649824657) — the Delphi-vs-FPC Format/Str last-digit rendering difference §1.3-2 relaxes to numeric-token comparison; the parsed probe diff is property-display precision (empirically ~6 sf), not an op-point move (expected == actual rounded to 6 sf). The port matches the pinned FPC oracle (mandatory gate green).
entries.source: WP-U1.10 r4088 sweep (controls:expcontrol_basic, controls:invcontrol_expmodel PVSystem.pv.kvar); r3723 sweep same class

entries.cause: Vsource unenergized-conductor power near-zero common mode: EPRI reports exactly (0,0) on conductor 2 where the port reports ~1e-4 VA (rel ~1e-7 on a 1 kV source) — the near-ideal-source/floating floor class. The port matches the pinned FPC oracle (mandatory gate green).
entries.source: WP-U1.10 r4088 sweep (Paulo_Example/subestacao Vsource.source cond 2); r3723 sweep same class

entries.cause: Same class as invcontrol-fixpoint-drift (EPRI 9.8 InvControl vs the port's fix take different control trajectories, V ~3.5e-4, rel ~5e-8) but on the lowercase synthetic controls-family decks that the sibling entry's case_contains 'InvControl/' does not match. Only appears vs r3723 (EPRI 9.8 InvControl bug); on r4088 these decks are cataloged under eventlog-trailing-space.
